behavior: Dialog.Portal, AlertDialog.Portal and Drawer.Portal take `disabled`. The portal element and its parts then render in the place of the part, on a server and before the mount. They hydrate with no mismatch, and the portal does not read `container`. The portal keeps no outside guards and no owner element. A popup that is not modal has no guards and keeps its place in the tab order. It closes when focus leaves it, unless `disablePointerDismissal` is true. The modal marks, focus trap and scroll lock follow changes of `modal` while the dialog is open. A plain element permits hydration on Vue 3.5.12, whose disabled Teleport still needs a target. A change of `disabled` mounts the content again. Base UI has no such prop. It renders the portal element in a container after the mount, so its server HTML has no popup.
